description: The flights of one UTC date read off positions reported by aircraft transponders under the flight number's broadcast callsign: the airline's ICAO designator and the number (matched_by callsign, with the callsigns tried). An airline whose callsigns do not follow its flight numbers returns nothing, and neither does a codeshare number. Each flight is one aircraft's observed takeoff and landing with the airport; each is a bracket (earliest_utc to latest_utc, at most 10 minutes apart), not a gate time, and a side not observed is null with reason not_observed. A flight belongs to the date its takeoff bracket starts in, or its landing's when no takeoff was observed. No schedule, delay or on-time verdict is given; get_flight_status has the recorded times. Airports where no position on the ground is received yield no takeoff or landing. A movement is provisional until the UTC hour of the position that completed it has ended and 20 more minutes have passed (at most 80 minutes): until then a late position can still narrow its bracket, settle or clear its callsign, or withdraw it. complete says whether every movement of the date has settled.

date.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD within the last 89 days. Defaults to today in UTC.

number.description: Flight number: airline IATA or ICAO code plus number, e.g. AA1.

name: get_observed_flights
